//: Secure Mode configuration for sensitive or client projects. Merge these
//usage: values into .antigravity/settings.json, or set the equivalents in
//usage2: Antigravity Settings > Security. This is the strict counterpart to
//keys: Key names change between releases; check antigravity.google/docs before
//keys2: relying on a specific key. Replace every example.com placeholder below
//keys3: with your own hosts before use.

resourceControls.//browser: Browser URL governance: an allowlist plus a denylist bounds where
resourceControls.//browser2: the browser subagent may go, and blocks external image fetches.
resourceControls.//network: Network governance. Deny by default, then allow what you need.

reviewPolicies.//: Forced review: nothing consequential happens without an explicit click.
reviewPolicies.//terminal: Every terminal command requires review, ignoring any allowlist.
reviewPolicies.//files: File writes require review; these patterns are never touched.
reviewPolicies.//browser: The browser subagent cannot run JavaScript without approval.
reviewPolicies.//plans: The agent cannot move from Plan to Act until you approve the plan.

fileIntegrity.//: Workspace isolation: the agent stays inside the project directory and
fileIntegrity.//2: honors .gitignore, which is what keeps .env out of its perception.

auditLogging.//: Audit trail, written locally. Add your own log sink if you have one.

modelRestrictions.//: Keep experimental and preview models out of regulated work. Fill
modelRestrictions.//2: allowedModels from Antigravity's model selector; names change between
modelRestrictions.//3: releases, so a stale allowlist blocks everything.

alerts.//: Security alerts. Replace the placeholders with your own destinations.
